task_text: Someone with the flu needs a place to rest and recover. I need a room set up within 20 minutes — comfortable to rest in, with easy access to water and any basics they might need.

plans.R1:
Based on the image and the objects listed, here's a plan for setting up a comfortable space for someone with the flu:

[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Fill the mug with water from the tap. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the filled mug on the counter for easy access. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the tea kettle from the counter. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Fill the tea kettle with water from the tap. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the filled tea kettle on the stove. (r1_s6)

[15-20 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Turn on the stove to heat the water in the kettle. (r1_s7)
- R1 [ASK_HELP] Request another robot to bring a blanket and pillow for comfort. (r1_s8)

This plan ensures that the person has access to water and the means to make tea, which can be soothing when recovering from the flu.
